mapper.select: SELECT id FROM course WHERE name = #{courseName}
SELECT e.id FROM learner_enrollment e JOIN course c ON c.id = e.course_id JOIN user u ON u.id = e.user_id WHERE c.name = #{courseName} and u.id = #{userId}
SELECT AVG(score) FROM test_submission WHERE learner_id = #{userId} and submission_status = 'COMPLETED'

SELECT d.date AS class_date, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT cs.name ORDER BY s.period_start_time SEPARATOR ', ') AS subject_names FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB(#{today}, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(#{today}) DAY) AS date UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(#{today}, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(#{today}) DAY), INTERVAL 1 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(#{today}, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(#{today}) DAY), INTERVAL 2 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(#{today}, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(#{today}) DAY), INTERVAL 3 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(#{today}, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(#{today}) DAY), INTERVAL 4 DAY) ) d LEFT JOIN course_schedule s ON s.course_id = #{courseId} AND s.class_date = d.date LEFT JOIN course_subject cs ON s.subject_id = cs.id GROUP BY d.date ORDER BY d.date

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM homework WHERE course_id = #{courseId}) AS homework_total_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(s.id) FROM homework_submission s JOIN homework h ON h.id = s.homework_id JOIN homework_eval e ON e.hs_id = s.id WHERE h.course_id = #{courseId} AND s.learner_id = #{userId} AND e.is_pass = 1) AS learner_homework_cnt;

SELECT d.dt AS participation_date, COALESCE(p.status, '미등록') AS status, p.check_in, p.check_out FROM ( SELECT DATE_ADD( DATE_SUB(#{today}, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(#{today}) DAY), INTERVAL seq.n DAY ) AS dt FROM ( SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 ) AS seq ) AS d LEFT JOIN participation p ON p.learner_enrollment_id = #{learnerEnrollmentId} AND DATE(p.participation_date) = d.dt ORDER BY d.dt
SELECT id, title, is_answered, is_answered_checked FROM community_inquiry WHERE writer = #{userId} AND is_posted = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT id, title, is_answer FROM course_qna WHERE writer_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 3

( SELECT id, title, is_fixed, created_at FROM course_notice WHERE is_fixed = true AND course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 3 ) UNION ALL ( SELECT id, title, is_fixed, created_at FROM course_notice WHERE is_fixed= false AND course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 2 )

SELECT f.id, f.title, f.forum_like, f.hotpost_at, COUNT(c.id) AS comment_count FROM course_forum f LEFT JOIN course_forum_comment c ON c.course_forum_id = f.id WHERE f.course_id = #{courseId} AND f.is_hotpost = 1 GROUP BY f.id, f.title, f.forum_like, f.hotpost_at ORDER BY f.hotpost_at DESC;

SELECT t.id AS test_id, t.title AS title, ROUND(avg_sub.avg_score, 1) AS avg_score, stu.score AS my_score, ROUND( 100.0 * ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_submission WHERE test_id = t.id AND submission_status = 'COMPLETED' AND score < stu.score ) / ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_submission WHERE test_id = t.id AND submission_status = 'COMPLETED' ) , 1) AS percentile FROM test t
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT test_id, AVG(score) AS avg_score FROM test_submission WHERE submission_status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY test_id ) AS avg_sub ON avg_sub.test_id = t.id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT test_id, score FROM test_submission WHERE submission_status = 'COMPLETED' AND learner_id = #{userId} ) AS stu ON stu.test_id = t.id WHERE t.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY t.id
